title: The hull's concrete as a solid block and as a hollow box (section)

provenance.basis: Illustrative archetype for projects/floating-city-design-challenge (scenario SCN_FLOATCITY_COASTAL_01); not an engineering design. Same concrete (1108.0 m3): a solid cube of 10.35 m sinks; the 40 x 40 x 4 m box floats at 1.621 m (analysis clay_boat; CLM_002, CLM_101).
